claudeErrors.CLAUDE_AUTHENTICATION_FAILED: Claude is not signed in or its credentials are invalid. Sign in or configure valid API credentials.
claudeErrors.CLAUDE_ORGANIZATION_NOT_ALLOWED: This Claude account is not allowed to access the organization. Check the account and organization authorization.
claudeErrors.CLAUDE_BILLING_ERROR: The Claude account has a billing issue. Check the subscription or payment settings.
claudeErrors.CLAUDE_CREDITS_EXHAUSTED: Claude usage credits are exhausted. Add credits and try again.
claudeErrors.CLAUDE_RATE_LIMITED: The Claude rate limit has been reached. Try again later.
claudeErrors.CLAUDE_SERVICE_OVERLOADED: Claude is currently overloaded. Try again later.
claudeErrors.CLAUDE_INVALID_REQUEST: Claude rejected the request as invalid. Check the generation settings and input.
claudeErrors.CLAUDE_MODEL_NOT_FOUND: The requested Claude model does not exist or is unavailable to this account.
claudeErrors.CLAUDE_SERVER_ERROR: Claude encountered an internal server error. Try again later.
claudeErrors.CLAUDE_API_ERROR: The Claude API returned an unknown error. Try again later.
claudeErrors.CLAUDE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS: Claude reached the maximum output token limit. Reduce the task scope and try again.
claudeErrors.CLAUDE_PERMISSION_DENIED: Claude does not have permission to use a required tool. Check the tool permissions.
claudeErrors.CLAUDE_MAX_TURNS_REACHED: Claude reached the maximum number of turns. Adjust the task or increase the turn limit.
claudeErrors.CLAUDE_MAX_BUDGET_EXCEEDED: Claude reached the spending limit for this task. Adjust the budget and try again.
claudeErrors.CLAUDE_STRUCTURED_OUTPUT_FAILED: Claude could not produce valid structured output after repeated attempts.
claudeErrors.CLAUDE_BLOCKING_LIMIT_REACHED: Claude reached a blocking usage limit. Wait for the limit to reset and try again.
claudeErrors.CLAUDE_RAPID_REFILL_BLOCKED: Claude stopped because requests were refilling too quickly. Try again later.
claudeErrors.CLAUDE_PROMPT_TOO_LONG: The request exceeds the Claude context window. Reduce the input and try again.
claudeErrors.CLAUDE_IMAGE_ERROR: Claude could not process an image in the request. Check its format, size, or content.
claudeErrors.CLAUDE_MODEL_ERROR: The Claude model failed to complete the request. Try again later or use another model.
claudeErrors.CLAUDE_MALFORMED_TOOL_USE: Claude repeatedly produced invalid tool input, so the task was stopped.
claudeErrors.CLAUDE_STREAM_ABORTED: The Claude response stream was interrupted. Try again.
claudeErrors.CLAUDE_TOOLS_ABORTED: Claude was interrupted while running required tools. Try again.
claudeErrors.CLAUDE_HOOK_BLOCKED: A Claude hook prevented the task from completing. Check the hook configuration.
claudeErrors.CLAUDE_TOOL_DEFERRED: Claude deferred a required tool call, so the task cannot continue.
claudeErrors.CLAUDE_TOOL_UNAVAILABLE: A tool deferred by Claude is unavailable. Check the tool configuration.
claudeErrors.CLAUDE_TURN_SETUP_FAILED: Claude could not prepare this request. Check the runtime configuration and try again.
claudeErrors.CLAUDE_BACKGROUND_TASK_UNSUPPORTED: Claude moved the task to background execution, which this workbench does not currently support.
claudeErrors.CLAUDE_MODEL_REFUSED: Claude refused the request and no fallback model was available.
claudeErrors.CLAUDE_NETWORK_ERROR: Claude could not be reached. Check the network connection and try again.
claudeErrors.CLAUDE_REQUEST_TIMEOUT: The Claude request timed out. Try again later.
claudeErrors.CLAUDE_CONFIGURATION_INVALID: The Claude configuration is invalid or unavailable. Check the workspace settings.
claudeErrors.CLAUDE_PROCESS_FAILED: The Claude Agent SDK process ended unexpectedly. Try again.
claudeErrors.CLAUDE_RUNTIME_INTERRUPTED: The Claude Agent SDK runtime was interrupted. Try again.
claudeErrors.CLAUDE_EXECUTION_FAILED: Claude could not complete the task. Try again or inspect the runtime logs.
